name: subway-candid-girl-on-phone
image_purpose: candid public-transit composition and casual outfit reference

prompt.project_info: Create a realistic candid photograph of an approved adult woman seated inside a subway carriage and focused on her phone.
prompt.main_subject: Approved adult woman with long natural hair, wearing a gray fitted but opaque short-sleeve top, black knee-length skirt, and white sneakers, looking down at her phone rather than at the camera.
prompt.composition_elements: Subject in the right third near the subway door, blurred foreground obstruction on the left, vertical door and handrails guiding the eye, carriage signage and framed poster kept generic, slightly imperfect candid composition.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Cool-toned subway lighting with soft overhead illumination, subtle shadows, shallow depth of field, real camera grain.
prompt.technical_specs: Photorealistic street photography, portrait 4:5, natural perspective, subject sharp with slightly blurred background, realistic motion and texture.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Candid realistic subway photograph of an approved adult woman seated near the carriage door, looking down at her phone. Place her in the right third with a blurred passenger obstruction on the left, vertical handrails and door lines, cool overhead lighting, gray top, black knee-length skirt, white sneakers, slight camera grain, and natural imperfect framing. No voyeuristic framing or personal data.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, underage, childlike, voyeuristic framing, sexualized pose, nudity, lingerie, transparent clothing, distorted anatomy, extra fingers, identifiable bystander, readable personal data, watermark, logo invention, public figure likeness.
